# Meeting Prep
## Steps
1. Pull the account/contact, deal stage, last results, and open items.
2. Summarize the last call's commitments (Fireflies) and what's outstanding.
3. Produce a 1-page brief: context, their likely asks, our 3 talking points, and the one decision to drive.

## Guardrails
- Read-only prep — never contact the client or change deal state from this skill.
- Every fact in the brief traces to CRM/transcript; flag unknowns instead of guessing.
